newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding via overnight or term system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding via overnight or term system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add reserves to the banking system on Thursday through a round of system repurchase agreements.
The RPs are is seen from overnight to multi-day.
A minority of analysts, however, anticipate no Fed action given the Fed's aggressivly added reserves -- including a coupon pass -- the past week.
On Wednesday, the Fed executed 14-day system RPs, which stretch into the next maintenance period, since the add need is projected to stay very high, analysts said.
Federal funds were trading at 5-9/16 percent, just above the 5-1/2 percent target rate.
But while funds do not pose a problem, analysts said Treasury deposits at the Fed do. Deposits remain at record levels, running about 24 percent ahead of last year, analysts noted.
